dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual and symmetrical geometric narrowing from the widest mid-body section toward the posterior peduncle.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light-grey to off-white median pixel intensity across the visible dorsal surface.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-frequency, faint greyish longitudinal streaks localized along the central dorsal axis.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient between the primary light-grey baseline and the darker pigmented streaks.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: A distinct, high-contrast dark elongated mark is visible along the central longitudinal axis.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: A longitudinal shadow-casting feature is present along the central dorsal midline, suggesting a significant topological ridge or depression.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent dark, linear mark located centrally on the dorsal plane.
